versions.changelog:
- Major skill rework: expanded from“抓取公众号文章”to a full-feature WeChat content writing/rewriting assistant.
- Article scraping code removed; now focused on topic selection, titles, outlines, writing, rewriting, formatting, and cover prompts for public accounts.
- Added reference files: style fingerprint, title patterns, opening/ending library, and banned phrases to support custom writing styles.
- Strict workflow and structure: confirmation of user input, stepwise output (topic, titles, outline, drafts, publishing-ready version, cover prompt).
- New detailed style/formatting requirements; emphasis on conversational, opinionated writing and publication-ready output.
